code_analysis.oof_generation: Inner CV splits on outer_train only. Each inner fold trains on subset, predicts non-overlapping subset.
code_analysis.fusion_weight_selection: Uses OOF predictions on outer_train vs outer_train labels only.
code_analysis.hp_selection: FP branch HP selection uses sel_splitter on outer_train only (random_state differs from inner_splitter).
code_analysis.test_prediction: Only after all selections frozen. Uses refitted models on full train, predicts test.
